sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE a.atom_id LIKE '%21%' OR a.atom_id LIKE '%22%' OR a.atom_id LIKE '%23%' OR a.atom_id LIKE '%24%' OR a.atom_id LIKE '%25%' 
AND m.label = '+'
